exact.本机 OpenClaw Gateway 启动失败。请在电脑启动 Gateway，: The local OpenClaw Gateway failed to start. Start it on the computer, review the error from OpenClaw, and try again.
exact.Host 未能确认本机 OpenClaw Gateway 已启动。请在电脑检查: Host could not confirm that the local OpenClaw Gateway started. Check the Gateway status and port on the computer, then try again.
exact.Host 无法确认本机 OpenClaw Gateway 端口状态。请在电脑检查: Host could not check the local OpenClaw Gateway port. On the computer, make sure the Gateway is running and the port is correct.
exact.此 OpenClaw 地址只能接入已运行的 Gateway。请在 Gateway: This OpenClaw address requires an already running Gateway. Start it on its computer, then reconnect Host.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 正在初始化。请等 Gateway 就绪后重试。: OpenClaw Gateway is initializing. Wait until it is ready and try again.
exact.缺少 OpenClaw Gateway 令牌。请在电脑的 Orbis Host: OpenClaw Gateway token missing. On your computer, open Orbis Host → OpenClaw, enter the Gateway token, and apply the change.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 令牌不匹配。请在电脑的 Orbis Host: The OpenClaw Gateway token does not match. Check the token in Orbis Host → OpenClaw on your computer and apply it again.
exact.缺少 OpenClaw Gateway 令牌。此连接由环境变量管理，请在电脑为: OpenClaw Gateway token missing. This connection is managed by environment variables. Set ORBIS_OPENCLAW_TOKEN for Orbis Host and restart Host.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 令牌不匹配。此连接由环境变量管理，请在电脑更新: The OpenClaw Gateway token does not match. This connection is managed by environment variables. Update ORBIS_OPENCLAW_TOKEN and restart Host.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 未配置所需的令牌。请先在 Gateway 所在: The Gateway itself is missing its required token. Fix authentication on the computer running the Gateway, then set the matching token in Orbis Host.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 拒绝了 Orbis Host 的设备令牌。请在: OpenClaw Gateway rejected the Orbis Host device token. Check the Gateway token on the computer, then reconnect Host.
exact.OpenClaw 等待设备批准。请在 OpenClaw 的设备列表批准 Orbi: OpenClaw is waiting for device approval. Approve Orbis Host in the OpenClaw device list, then reconnect Host.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 已启动，等待在 OpenClaw 中批准 Or: The Gateway started. Approve Orbis Host in the OpenClaw device list, then reconnect Host.
exact.OpenClaw 的设备申请已被拒绝或过期。请重新连接 Host，再在 Open: The OpenClaw device request was rejected or expired. Reconnect Host and review the new request in the OpenClaw device list.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 拒绝了当前认证方式。请在电脑核对 Gatewa: OpenClaw Gateway rejected this authentication method. Check whether the Gateway supports token authentication or contact the Gateway administrator.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 暂时限制了认证请求。请稍等一会儿再重试。: OpenClaw Gateway has temporarily rate-limited authentication. Wait a moment and try again.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 与 Orbis Host 的版本不兼容。请在电: The OpenClaw Gateway and Orbis Host versions are incompatible. Check both versions, use a supported version, then reconnect Host.

exact.OpenClaw Gateway 未授予所需的会话权限。请检查 Orbis Ho: OpenClaw Gateway did not grant the required session access. Check the permissions for Orbis Host on the Gateway or contact its administrator.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 未及时回复会话检查。请等待 Gateway 就: OpenClaw Gateway did not reply to the session check in time. Wait until it is ready and retry. If this persists, check the Gateway diagnostics.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 未确认会话可访问。请在电脑查看 Gateway: OpenClaw Gateway did not confirm session access. Check the Gateway diagnostics on the computer, then reconnect Host.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 的 TLS 校验失败。请在电脑核对远程地址和证: TLS verification for OpenClaw Gateway failed. Check the remote address and certificate on the computer, then reconnect Host.
exact.Host 未能确认 OpenClaw Gateway 已接入。请在电脑核对 Ga: Host could not confirm a connection to OpenClaw Gateway. Check the Gateway address and status on the computer, then reconnect Host.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 未确认这次启动。请先核对原启动和会话列表，不要: OpenClaw Gateway did not confirm this launch. Check the previous launch and the session list before creating another session.
exact.电脑端未能确认 OpenClaw 配置。请在电脑检查 Orbis Host 的状: Your computer could not confirm the OpenClaw configuration. Check Orbis Host status and diagnostics on the computer, then try again.
exact.OpenClaw Gateway 未能恢复此会话。请先刷新会话列表；若仍失败，请: OpenClaw Gateway could not reopen this session. Refresh the session list first. If this persists, check Gateway status and permissions on the computer.
exact.此 OpenClaw 会话在当前 Gateway 上不可用。请刷新会话列表，或先: This OpenClaw session is unavailable on the current Gateway. Refresh the session list, or restore the archived session in OpenClaw first.
